blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Akari barged into the win column after sweeping PLDT, 25-18, 25-19, 25-22, in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series on Tuesday at Mall of Asia Arena. Eli Soyud led the Chargers’ collective effort with 12 points off 11 kills and one block. Fifi Sharma delivered seven points, including the game-winning attack that snapped their two-game skid. “Our two losses were tough on everyone, and I think that’s where our motivation came from.
